backup.production_rule: Policy and grant changes only, no data change, applied after the s79 release or independent of it (no shared object). Four exposures closed, read from the live catalog 2026-10-13. (A) telegram_chat_history: policy service_role_all (FOR ALL TO public USING true) dropped, service_role-only policy created, all grants revoked from public/anon/authenticated; the only code that touches it is the telegram-cassy and telegram-expense edge functions with the service key. (B) inventory_purchases: policies 'anon all' and 'authenticated all' dropped; one authenticated policy inventory_purchases_staff_all admits current_staff_authorized(manage_inventory) on the item's property (owner, admin); anon and public grants revoked, authenticated loses truncate/references/trigger. The admin dashboard Inventory purchases tab (owner/admin) is the only client reader; the cleaner checklist writes inventory_usage and reads inventory_items, both untouched. (C) inventory_audit_log: 'anon select' and 'anon insert' dropped, service_role-only policy, all grants revoked from public/anon/authenticated; no client reads it, writers are service_role and definer functions. (D) booking_inquiries_staff_read and airbnb_reservations_staff_read (read_operations) replaced by *_finance_read (read_finance: owner, admin, finance); cleaners, inspectors and maintenance lose direct API reads of guest e-mail, phone, totals, deposits, receipt paths and payouts (D-306, D-319). Owner/admin policies and service_role are untouched. restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: take a fresh backup as the LAST act before the apply and fill both (fill-restore-point.mjs).

forward_verification.name: anon_holds_nothing_on_chat_history_purchases_audit_log
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from (values ('telegram_chat_history'), ('inventory_purchases'), ('inventory_audit_log')) v(t) where has_table_privilege('anon', 'public.' || v.t, 'select,insert,update,delete,truncate,references,trigger'))

forward_verification.name: no_anon_or_public_policy_on_the_three_tables
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename in ('telegram_chat_history', 'inventory_purchases', 'inventory_audit_log') and roles && array['anon', 'public']::name[])

forward_verification.name: no_anon_or_public_true_policy_anywhere_in_public
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and roles && array['anon', 'public']::name[] and coalesce(qual, 'true') = 'true' and coalesce(with_check, 'true') = 'true')

forward_verification.name: authenticated_holds_nothing_on_chat_history_and_audit_log
forward_verification.query: select not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.telegram_chat_history', 'select,insert,update,delete,truncate,references,trigger') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.inventory_audit_log', 'select,insert,update,delete,truncate,references,trigger')

forward_verification.name: purchases_policy_is_manage_inventory_only
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 1 and bool_and(policyname = 'inventory_purchases_staff_all' and roles = '{authenticated}' and qual like '%manage_inventory%' and with_check like '%manage_inventory%') from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'inventory_purchases'

forward_verification.name: service_role_keeps_dml_and_a_policy_on_the_three_tables
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.' || v.t, 'select,insert,update,delete')) and (select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and policyname in ('telegram_chat_history_service_only', 'inventory_audit_log_service_only') and roles = '{service_role}') = 2 from (values ('telegram_chat_history'), ('inventory_purchases'), ('inventory_audit_log')) v(t)

forward_verification.name: booking_staff_read_is_read_finance_not_read_operations
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 2 and bool_and(qual like '%read_finance%' and qual not like '%read_operations%' and cmd = 'SELECT' and roles = '{authenticated}') from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and policyname in ('booking_inquiries_finance_read', 'airbnb_reservations_finance_read')

forward_verification.name: old_read_operations_policies_gone
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename in ('booking_inquiries', 'airbnb_reservations') and qual like '%read_operations%')

forward_verification.name: owner_admin_and_service_booking_policies_intact
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and policyname in ('booking_inquiries_owner_admin_select', 'airbnb_reservations_owner_admin_all', 'service role full access') and tablename in ('booking_inquiries', 'airbnb_reservations')) = 3 and has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.booking_inquiries', 'select,insert,update,delete') and has_table_privilege('service_role', 'public.airbnb_reservations', 'select,insert,update,delete')

forward_verification.name: cleaner_submit_path_grants_untouched
forward_verification.query: select has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.inventory_usage', 'insert') and has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.inventory_items', 'select') and has_table_privilege('authenticated', 'public.calendar_events', 'select')

rollback.safe_until: always (policies and grants only; no data is touched). Rolling back reopens the exposures.

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261013_s80_rls_tighten.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh: restores the exact prior policies (service_role_all TO public, 'anon all', 'authenticated all', 'anon select', 'anon insert', booking_inquiries_staff_read and airbnb_reservations_staff_read on read_operations) and the prior full grants to anon and authenticated on the three tables. Re-close the same day.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_policy_only
feature_flags.required_state: None. No code ships with this release. Clients that read booking_inquiries / airbnb_reservations directly (admin dashboard bookings, today, search, guests, finance) are owner/admin/finance screens; a cleaner, inspector or maintenance session reaching them now gets an empty list (D-324: not a supported path). The cleaner checklist, staff app and all edge functions are unaffected.
